title_en: Narathiwat police encircle and kill three assailants in shooting row, Si Sakhon Police Station.
summary_en: Police are surrounding a shootout in Ban Thongno, Si Sakhon district, Narathiwat. A policeman from Si Sakhon police station died on the day of the shooting. Two officers were injured and three suspects have been killed.
